description: Orkestra: denetim ayrımı ve yazma alanı kapıları, ortak defter, ajan x süreç token defteri, bitiş kapısı, perspektif tetiği. Yalnız .claude/orkestra/ açık projelerde iş yapar.

hooks.command: if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SessionStart; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SessionStart; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SessionStart; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sessionstart_kritik.py"; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sessionstart_kritik.py"; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sessionstart_kritik.py"; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" UserPromptSubmit; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" UserPromptSubmit; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" UserPromptSubmit; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreToolUse; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreToolUse; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreToolUse; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUse; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUse; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUse; fi

case "${ORKESTRA_OTO_COMMIT:-0}" in 0|"") exit 0;; esac; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/oto_commit.py"; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/oto_commit.py"; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/oto_commit.py"; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUseFailure; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUseFailure; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PostToolUseFailure; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SubagentStart; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SubagentStart; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" SubagentStart; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Stop; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Stop; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Stop; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Notification; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Notification; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" Notification; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreCompact; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreCompact; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" PreCompact; fi

if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" ConfigChange; elif command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec py -3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" ConfigChange; else exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook.py" ConfigChange; fi
